text.en: So you're the one they sent. Knight-Captain, was it? Or is it just Kael now?
text.id: Jadi kau yang mereka kirim. Kapten Pengawal, ya? Atau sekarang cuma Kael?

text.en: Doesn't matter much out here. The land doesn't read titles. Are you staying, or are you dying? Both are honest answers.
text.id: Di sini itu tak penting. Tanah tidak membaca gelar. Kau mau tinggal, atau mau mati? Dua-duanya jawaban jujur.

text.en: I'm staying. Show me the hearth.
How many people are still alive here?
text.id: Berapa orang yang masih hidup di sini?

text.en: Who told the Protector this valley was worthless?
text.id: Siapa yang bilang ke Protektor bahwa lembah ini tak berharga?

text.en: Good. Then the first thing you learn is this: light the fire before dark, keep it lit, and never bury anyone outside the ring.
text.id: Bagus. Pelajaran pertamamu: nyalakan api sebelum gelap, jaga tetap menyala, dan jangan kubur siapa pun di luar lingkaran.

text.en: Alive? Me. That's the whole census. The rest are... still here, mind you. Just not the talking sort.
text.id: Hidup? Aku. Itu seluruh sensusnya. Sisanya masih di sini, kok. Cuma bukan jenis yang bisa diajak bicara.

text.en: Hah. Clever question. Nobody told him it was worthless. They told him it was dangerous. That's why he gave it to you.
text.id: Hah. Pertanyaan cerdas. Tak ada yang bilang lembah ini tak berharga. Mereka bilang ini berbahaya. Makanya dia berikan padamu.

text.en: Get some rest. Tomorrow we dig. Not graves, for once. Foundations.
text.id: Istirahatlah. Besok kita menggali. Sekali ini bukan kubur, tapi pondasi.
